info.title: Bartholomew Trust Protocol (BTP Guard)
info.description: Sub-35µs In-Process & Remote AST Execution Firewall and L402 Lightning Micropayment Gate for Autonomous AI Agents.

servers.description: Hosted Bartholomew MCP Gateway & Alby Hub Node

post.summary: Evaluate candidate tool action against BTP AST security invariants
post.description: Evaluates shell commands, SQL queries, code snippets, or API requests in sub-35µs before physical execution. Blocks destructive commands (rm -rf, mkfs, dd), SQL mutations (DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE), secret leaks, and runaway spend loops.

200.description: Action evaluated and cleared or denied with cryptographic attestation receipt.

402.description: Payment Required via L402 Lightning Network Micropayment. Header WWW-Authenticate contains macaroon and invoice.

WWW-Authenticate.description: L402 macaroon and lightning invoice challenge string.

403.description: Security veto triggered by catastrophic pattern or secret exfiltration attempt.

get.summary: Check gateway node health and Alby Hub Lightning state

200.description: Gateway status and active lightning backend information.

action.description: The command, SQL query, code string, or tool argument payload to evaluate.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the calling autonomous agent.

amount_usd.description: Estimated financial spend or tool cost in USD for budget invariant tracking.

allowed.description: True if action is approved; False if vetoed.

reason.description: Explanation of the verdict or policy rule matched.

receipt.description: Cryptographic Ed25519 attestation receipt for audit verification.
